Lifting risk depends on equipment, load, ground, weather, configuration, route, competence and supervision.

Hydraulic-injection severity depends on pressure, proximity, jet size, injected fluid, body site and treatment delay.

Runway-event risk depends on aerodrome layout, traffic, markings, visibility, communications, procedures and human performance.

Mumps risk depends on immunity, contact intensity, setting, age, symptoms and timing of exposure.

Varicella risk depends on immunity, contact, setting, pregnancy or immune status, symptoms and exposure timing.

RSV risk depends on age, season, exposure, pregnancy or infant status, comorbidity, immunity and timing.
